summary: Regression pass for SafeJSONResponse + _scrub_nonfinite_data startup routine. Backend starts cleanly (Application startup complete; scrub logged 'Scrubbed non-finite numbers from 1 document(s)' during earlier boot then clean thereafter). Admin login (9513242807/Repro@123) returns 200 with access_token+user. All 9 requested endpoints return 200. Frontend loads dashboard rendering both project cards (Vacation Village 0/256, Central Vista Farms 0/47) with Total Sold/Received/Pending = ₹0.00, and Projects/Units/Sales/Team all navigate without errors or blank screens.
critical_code_review_comments: Prior deploy had a NameError: _scrub_nonfinite_data referenced before definition (backend.err.log). It has since been resolved by hot reload; ensure the function is defined at module level above startup() in production build to avoid a repeat outage on cold start.
seed_data_creation: None. DB state kept clean (0 sold / 0 payments / 0 cancellations).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend project list uses field 'project_id' (not 'id'). Login payload key is 'phone' (not email). Two seed projects: proj_53fb360c1f0a (VV, 256), proj_01d7e89ba838 (CVF, 47).
rca of the issue: Historical: Cloudflare 520 traced to NaN/Inf floats from spreadsheet import breaking JSON serialization. Mitigations verified in this run: (a) SafeJSONResponse as default_response_class sanitizes non-finite at response time; (b) _scrub_nonfinite_data() at startup scans units/payments/cancellations and $sets sanitized values (observed sanitising 1 doc during a prior boot). No 5xx observed; login + post-login load path healthy.
